topic: Dashboard deployment and data access issue
summary_markdown:
A data dashboard was experiencing zero values for a specific client in the production environment. The issue was traced to an incomplete deployment of new demography features.

[me] suggested two options: deploying the update to production or rolling back the changes to maintain functionality without demography data.

[p1] confirmed that the updates needed to be deployed to production for Media Owners (MOs) to view the correct data. [me] subsequently deployed the fix, which resolved the issue and allowed [p1] to confirm successful access.
decisions: The new demography dashboard update was deployed to the production environment.
